notes.title: Devlog #8:Sea battle and new demo update
notes.notes:
Hey guys

For several weeks, we developing new system in Perang Laut-Maritime Warfare: Sea battle

So what's like sea battle in this game? This several screenshots how like the sea battle in this game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/0c46b12a40c6287192744bfd0961edef99563ac4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/b405927619c6867a6e017a475da4655cc788a75e.jpg
There are 4 orders in commanding ships:
1.Hit and run:attacking with arrows/guns/cannons(depends on technology ) and use speed of ships 
2.Boarding:attacking enemy by boarding to enemy ships and takeover each ships. This order very useful for large number of troop
3.Burning: burning ship and attacking it to enemy ship.
4.Flee:running from battle.

This is what we can tell for now.

New demo update has updated several days ago and have some new features.

For new update for main build the Perang Laut-Maritime Warfare, hope we can finish it before 24 November 2021.

Thank you.

notes.title: Devlog #5 Mandala Power and About Release date
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Long time not to update the devlog since Sengkala Dev busy in making AI about 1 month..

In Perang Laut, faction's system use mandala against another factions for war. Trade rights depends how good relation between factions like and allies system depends on war( your enemy my enemy is our enemy )

So what is mandala? Mandala is imaginer circle fame the ruler and related ancient Indian and Southeast Asian political system . So when two mandala circle clashed, war will start like Srivijaya's mandala clash with Mallaca. Wait, Mallaca is Islam so is their still use mandala? Yes. Mandala system widely used even for Eastern Indonesian kingdoms such as Ternate and Tidore although have different concept.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/8a9dcc0b22b5f8784be7b9f06ceb5fc7d9d2b310.jpg

So this system quite unique right? Probably you have see this system in demo.

About release date. 18 October is release date (19 October in Indonesia). Probably the release date will change since game still under development (AI problem). Hope we can release in this week.

Thank you for your attention

notes.title: Devlog #2 Diplomatic and demo version
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,Sengkala Dev have update again about features.

Since 2015, we have diplomatic system feature in Pedalahusa Fall of Bali. The system quite good since develop in long time but still have problem. And now there are diplomatic system. The root of diplomatic system start in July 2019, but abandoned since we don't have any budget...

Now we establish the diplomatic system in this game and under development.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/b3acea4015076aff3ccc7d24c562913c56be85be.jpg

So what is diplomatic system in Perang Laut? What different from before?

Before no diplomatic system, Majapahit can attacking Srivijaya and Srivijaya can attack Mallaca but with diplomatic system, all factions will think first before declaring war against another factions. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/5b218e3c4d00852b90926166fa919722b39d51b5.jpg

Oh, demo has live. You can try it and report problem happen in playing the demo. Demo is preview where player only can play as Majapahit and understanding game system in 1 year game length. Demo will update soon after we done the diplomatic system so in new demo player can understand the diplomatic system.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/1516a777365ab66a290fb4fda1beeac6500beca0.jpg
Thank you
